notes.subject: לנמהרי לב
notes.rationale: 'ba pelo ye eibilego/ye e hlahlamilego' ka go tsela (KJV 'fearful of heart', YLT 'hastened of heart') — mothalo wa pele ke boofoša bja pelo, e sego tšhogo fela.

notes.subject: יבוא ... יבוא
notes.rationale: Go bulela ga lenti gapedi ('o tla ... yena o tla') go matlafatsa tumelo; phetolelo ya Sepedi e bolotše go tliša gapedi ga 'o tla'.

notes.subject: imperatives
notes.rationale: Temana e laela ka boikengšo: 'Le re', 'Nonofalang', 'le se ke la tšhoga', 'bonang' — e bitša basebišwa go tsenelela.

notes.subject: to the fearful-hearted
notes.rationale: Puo e lebjetše kgofo go bao pelo ya bona e didimetšego, ka bobedi 'lona' (Elohim wa lona).

notes.subject: pheto
notes.rationale: נקם ke pheto ya tlolo (go bušetša molato); 'kahlolo' noša e ka la e šomiša ge e sego ga kahlolo ya toka.

translation: Le re go bao pelo ya bona e didimetšego: Nonofalang, le se ke la tšhoga; bonang, Elohim wa lona o tla a tliša pheto; modiro wa go duela — wa Elohim — yena o tla go lokaša lona.

tokens.gloss: gomme o tla go lokaša lona
